verdict.rationale: three.js is published on npm (verified via npm registry probe showing v0.186.0 and 12M weekly downloads, MIT licensed), and docs/examples show standard ESM import patterns (import maps, tree-shakable module usage) that integrate with modern bundler toolchains; community confirms TypeScript compatibility. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of documented tree-shaking behavior/bundle-size guidance or bundler-specific (webpack/vite/rollup) integration guides, and no independent case study confirming tree-shaking works in practice.
